content: The export function takes forever. I tried to export a 500-row report and it timed out after 3 minutes. This is blocking our end-of-month reporting.
We need Slack notifications when a report is shared with us. Right now we have no idea when something is ready.
The dashboard loads so slowly on Firefox. It takes 8-10 seconds every time we open it.
I cannot find the CSV export button anywhere. Where did it go after the last update?
Our team needs role-based permissions. Right now everyone can see everything including salary data.
The mobile app crashes when I try to view charts on my iPhone 14. Very frustrating.
We need an audit log to see who changed what. This is a compliance requirement for us.
The search function returns wrong results. I searched for a client name and got completely unrelated results.
Exporting to PDF generates a blank file. I've tried 5 times with different browsers.
We desperately need SSO support. Managing separate passwords for 200 employees is not feasible.
The API rate limits are too low. We hit 429 errors after 50 requests. We need at least 500 per minute.
Dashboard takes 12 seconds to load. On my old laptop it's even worse. Please optimize this.
When I export a report the column headers are missing. I have to manually add them every time.
Can you add email notifications for when scheduled reports are ready? We check every morning.
The search bar doesn't search within report descriptions. Only titles are searchable.
We need granular permission controls. Marketing shouldn't see finance dashboards.
The export CSV has encoding issues with special characters. German umlauts show as question marks.
Loading time is killing our team's productivity. We open the app 20+ times a day.
We need webhook support to trigger actions when a report is updated.
Slack integration would save us so much time. We spend 30 minutes a day checking the app for updates.
The PDF export cuts off the last two columns. This has been broken for two months.
Can we get two-factor authentication? Our security team is requiring it for all SaaS tools.
Report generation is painfully slow. A simple 100-row report takes 45 seconds to generate.
Search is broken. When I type a customer name nothing comes up even though I can see them in the list.
We need to export reports as Excel files not just CSV. Our clients only work with Excel.
The app is unusable on mobile. Charts are too small to read and buttons are hard to click.
I need to see who accessed which reports last week. We had a data incident and need to investigate.
Every time I open a dashboard it reloads from scratch. Why doesn't it cache anything?
We need custom user roles. Right now it's just admin or viewer with nothing in between.
Notifications would be incredibly useful. We miss updates because we forget to check the dashboard.
The export is taking way too long. Our finance team is waiting on reports for board presentations.
Can we integrate with Microsoft Teams? We don't use Slack but we need something similar.
The search needs to search across all fields. Right now it misses results we know exist.
We got a GDPR request and need to export all data for a specific user. There is no way to do this.
Dashboard performance has gotten worse with each update. It used to load in 2 seconds now it's 9.
